MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small Gorilla glue felt useful for minor repairs alongside my recent fasteners, and its brush and nozzle would help me apply it precisely.",
    "Repair supplies fit part of my recent shopping, although only the precision glue matched a need I would act on now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The finish nails resemble my framing nails, but their purpose and tool requirements differ; a similar length does not make them suitable substitutes.",
    "The decorating assortment does not follow naturally from buying screw-in anchors, and the bucket, gloves, reacher and caulk caps lack a clear current use for me.",
    "The waterproof adhesive offers a capability I do not currently need; I preferred the smaller glue with precise applicators."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My nail purchases seem to have been treated as interest in nails generally, without enough attention to framing versus finishing work.",
    "Buying hardware and medicine cups seems to have been stretched into a broad need for household, maintenance and medical supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The framing nails I selected specify collation angle, shank and dimensions, so compatibility matters more to me than simply recommending another nail product.",
    "I choose supplies for particular tasks; one purchase of medicine cups or anchors does not establish an ongoing need for related accessories.",
    "For the repair adhesive I would choose now, controlled application matters more than waterproof bonding."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my repair-related shopping but often mistook broad similarity for the specific purpose and compatibility I need."
}
